title: Bouncing Subterror
prompt: complex upbeat bassline with roaring synths
description: A bouncy sub-low bassline where a sine sub is thickened by a detuned saw an octave up, gated through shifting euclidean rhythms. Over 16 cycles the FM index, ladder filter and gate density morph from rounded thump to roaring, restless drive.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
stack(
  note("<f1 f1 ab1 c2 f1 eb1 db1 c2>(<5 7 5 3>/2,8)").s("sine")
    .fm(sine.slow(16).range(1.5, 9)).fmh("<1 2 1.5 0.5>/4")
    .penv("<8 0 12 4>/8").pattack(0.001).pdecay(0.07)
    .lpf(sine.slow(24).range(220, 2600)).resonance(13).ftype("ladder")
    .lpenv(sine.slow(32).range(2, 5)).lpattack(0.005).lpdecay(0.13)
    .attack(0.003).decay(0.18).sustain(0.45).release(0.05)
    .shape(saw.slow(12).range(0.2, 0.5)).postgain(0.9)
    .off(0.005, x => x.add(note(12.07)).s("sawtooth").gain(0.32).pan(0.7).lpf(1800))
    .pan(sine.slow(7).range(0.35, 0.65))
    .room(0.16).gain(0.9)
)
